citation.title: Meal rich in carbohydrate, but not protein or fat, reveals adverse immunometabolic responses associated with obesity

reported.what: fasting NEFA of the 9 lean insulin-sensitive men, mean ± SEM (Table 1)

location.where: Table 1, row 'Fasting NEFA (mmol/l)', column LIS subjects

detail: Both groups are selected by HOMA-IR as well as BMI (lean HOMA-IR < 1.2; obese insulin-resistant), so their fasting values carry the selection, and NEFA as much as glucose and insulin; no unselected group is reported. The mixed-meal glucose and insulin curves are only in figures, and the meal grams only in a supplement outside the XML.
